descriptions.en: Generic WebSocket Bridge for Home Assistant that dynamically registers devices and entities from external WebSocket clients.
descriptions.ko: 외부 WebSocket 클라이언트에서 기기와 엔티티를 동적으로 등록하는 Home Assistant 통합구성요소입니다.

categories_review.source: README.md: Generic WebSocket Bridge for Home Assistant that dynamically registers devices and entities from external WebSocket clients. Primary purpose is connecting external scripts/makers to Home Assistant over WebSocket (diy_makers.web_data_connectors) as a protocol bridge (hubs_protocols). Reviewed 2026-10-21 against official taxonomy https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/ec18d8b25d1ee39aa8b85a72a170e42bee33228c/homeassistant/generated/integration_categories.json .
